g.title: PersonSearch
g.text: Phase 1 walks every HTML table first (no CAPTCHA) and stores it; phase 2 requests the documents (CAPTCHA) and parses the downloads
Rule: at every table, repeat the request for EACH row, unless that row's data is already extracted

g.title: cluster_p2
